reasoning_steps: Original time period T = 2pi sqrt(I / (MB)) = 2 s.
The phrase cut along its length into three equal parts in this context implies making cuts along the length, dividing it into three shorter magnets of length L/3 (transverse cuts).
Each piece has mass m/3, length L/3, and magnetic moment M/3.
Stacking them with like poles together gives a total mass m, length L/3, and total magnetic moment M.
Moment of inertia of the stack I_new = m(L/3)^2 / 12 = I / 9.
New time period T_new = 2pi sqrt((I/9) / (MB)) = (1/3) * T = 2/3 s.
